heading: I’m Ryan Elijah, and I’m running for Congress in Florida’s District 7.
text: For the past 14 years Ryan Elijah has been a very visible part of the community — building strong bonds with area leaders, giving him a unique position to bring your concerns and needs to the right people at the highest levels.

heading: Meet Ryan Elijah
text: A message from Ryan to the families of Seminole and Volusia counties.

heading: Faith, family, and Central Florida.
text: Ryan and his wife, Tasha, have raised their two boys in Seminole County. As a long-time Florida resident of 20 years — 14 of them in District 7 — he is committed to fighting for conservative Florida values.

heading: Faith, family, and Central Florida.
text: Family is the foundation of our strong communities in Central Florida. Ryan is active in his church and believes in protecting family values.

heading: Endorsements
text: Ryan has earned the support of Florida’s governor, both of the district’s sheriffs, and members of Florida’s congressional delegation.

heading: Voter Action Center
text: Florida’s 7th District covers all of Seminole County and southern Volusia County. Here’s everything you need to cast your ballot for Ryan.

heading: Vote by Mail
text: Request your ballot from your county Supervisor of Elections, then return it by mail or to a secure drop-off location. Ballots must be received by 7:00 p.m. on Election Day — postmarks don’t count, so mail early.

heading: Vote Early
text: Skip the Election Day lines and vote in person at any early-voting site in your county. Dates, hours, and locations are set by each county Supervisor of Elections — confirm before you go.

heading: Vote on Election Day
text: Polls are open 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Find your assigned precinct and polling place before you head out to vote for Ryan.

heading: Vote on Election Day
text: Not sure if you’re registered, or if you live in Congressional District 7? Check your registration status with the Florida Division of Elections.

heading: Key Objectives
text: As a public figure, Ryan Elijah has been immersed in the community and has heard your concerns. Once elected, he will bring them to those who can help get them addressed.

heading: Affordability & Economy
text: Congress must continue driving down costs for American families by keeping taxes low and achieving American energy independence. Lower gas prices are critical to our economy because they reduce costs for families, businesses, and everything we buy.

heading: Affordability & Economy
text: It’s past time to put a stop to out of control government spending that acts to drive up everyday costs for American families and our national debt.

heading: Affordability & Economy
text: Ryan understands that burdensome federal regulations will slow job creation and economic growth.

heading: Affordability & Economy
text: By unleashing the world’s best economy through lower taxes, less regulation, and smart growth, we will make America more affordable and prosperous for millions of Americans.

heading: Healthcare
text: Ryan supports solutions that deliver affordable, patient-centered healthcare options. He also believes healthcare costs can be reduced by providing individuals with tax benefits, such as expanded Health Savings Accounts.

heading: Healthcare
text: Additionally, Ryan supports greater transparency in the system, including requirements for clear pricing from hospitals, insurers, and other providers.

heading: Consumer Protection
text: Floridians lose hundreds of millions of dollars to fraud every year. During his television career, Ryan spent years fighting for consumers—taking on complex federal cases and recovering thousands of dollars for victims.

heading: Consumer Protection
text: He will support strong consumer-protection legislation and aggressively pursue those who prey on Floridians, especially our most vulnerable senior citizens.

heading: Beach Protection
text: Volusia County’s beaches drive a $4.3 billion economy and serve as our first line of defense against storms. Hurricanes Ian and Nicole severely damaged our shoreline.

heading: Beach Protection
text: Ryan will prioritize working with federal agencies to secure long-term beach nourishment and storm-damage reduction projects.

heading: Education
text: Ryan will strongly support our schools. His boys were educated in both public and private schools. He believes both are critical to our children’s success and our community’s future.

heading: Education
text: That’s why he champions parental rights and school choice, empowering families to make the best decisions for their kids and have transparency on curriculum.

heading: Education
text: Federal funding is important for the district, with the most recent audit showing Seminole County’s budget is comprised of nearly 14% federal funding, while Volusia County is closer to 20%. (National Center for Education Statistics, 2022/23 school year)

heading: Education
text: We must protect local control and ensure every dollar serves our students effectively.

heading: Faith, Family and Life
text: As your representative, he will champion policies that support parents, protect children, and keep families united and strong.

heading: Faith, Family and Life
text: Ryan is pro-life and believes every life is a sacred gift from God.

heading: The Military & Veterans
text: We must ensure that the U.S. military remains the strongest and best-equipped fighting force in the world, backed by the most advanced technology.

heading: The Military & Veterans
text: We must also guarantee that our veterans receive the best possible care after their service to our nation.

heading: Law Enforcement
text: Ryan is a strong defender of law enforcement and deeply understands the daily challenges officers face. He will strongly support legislation that protects law enforcement, including tougher penalties for assaulting or shooting officers.

heading: Law Enforcement
text: He is a staunch supporter of the Second Amendment and has earned an “A” rating with the NRA.

heading: Law Enforcement
text: Ryan has received multiple honors for his outstanding support of law enforcement.

heading: Illegal Immigration
text: We must continue to secure our borders and oppose any measures that weaken enforcement or prioritize non-citizens over American safety.

heading: Illegal Immigration
text: Ryan will work with local law enforcement to stop the flood of illegal drugs that damage our Central Florida communities.

heading: Illegal Immigration
text: He strongly supports the Save America Act, which ensures only American citizens can vote in our elections — because citizenship must matter.
